ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Client development, Terms sent and later stages need Search model, Fee percent and Exclusivity.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Client_development", CASE(StageName, "Target", 1, "Conversation", 2, "Terms discussed", 3, "Terms sent", 4, "Terms signed", 5, 0) >= 4, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Search_model__c)), ISBLANK(Fee_percent__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Exclusivity__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Search model, Fee percent and Exclusivity before moving to Terms sent.
